notes: ὁ is the substantival article of ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν and takes 'he'; the ASV writes a second word for the participle, so rule 32 splits the pair and rule 90's single-word arm does not apply.
πάντα is anarthrous and heads on 'all', the supplied 'things' being the generic completion (rule 17); rule 102 is not in play, no article governing the phrase.
μέν takes the written 'indeed' under rule 70's English-side test.
